findings.description: Step 8 filters criteria_outcomes entries using 'status: pass' but the JSON schema (gate-verdict.schema.json) defines the enum as ["met", "deferred", "failed"] — "pass" is not a valid status value. A consumer following the command spec literally would find zero matching entries even when all criteria are met.
findings.evidence: phase-compact.md line 163: 'one bullet per entry where `status: pass`'; gate-verdict.schema.json line 88: "enum": ["met", "deferred", "failed"]

findings.description: The locked cold-artefact schema requires 'phase' to be an integer (not a string). The phase-6-complete.md writes phase: 6 without quotes, which is correct YAML integer syntax. No violation — noted for awareness only.
findings.evidence: plans/phase-completes/phase-6-complete.md line 2: 'phase: 6' (unquoted) — conforms to docs/phase-complete.schema.md Field Rules 'Integer, not a string'

findings.description: Step 2 uses 'ls plans/phase-[N].md 2>/dev/null' with shell meta-brackets that could match phase-10.md when N=1 on some systems. This is a minor shell-glob precision issue in illustrative bash; the surrounding prose is clear about intent. Does not affect correctness of the spec as a whole.
findings.evidence: phase-compact.md Step 2 code block: 'ls plans/phase-[N].md 2>/dev/null || ls plans/phase-[N]-*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1'

findings.description: Phase 7 itself is marked complete in the Phases table and Compaction Programme table but no Phase 7 cold artefact entry appears in the Phase Completions section.
